verdict.rationale: Letta's 'dreaming' feature explicitly uses background subagents to review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons, and update memory without interrupting active work, plus explicit /remember for direct teaching and /doctor for auditing drift/duplication — matching the story's self-directed extraction and background consolidation. Community commentary corroborates the memory-first, continual-learning design (Charles/Letta describing agents that build learned context over time). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of dreaming's extraction quality/accuracy and detail on what triggers salience decisions beyond step-count/context-compaction.
